ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SLUGGISH.title: Sluggish
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SLUGGISH.description: Each stack lowers attack damage dealt by 5%. Whenever an enemy gains 1 Sluggish, it loses 1 random positive buff. At the trigger threshold, enemies lose that many stacks and become Stunned; the player clears Sluggish and becomes Stunned this turn.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SILENCE.title: Silence
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SILENCE.description: This creature cannot use skills this turn.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SHIVER.title: Shiver
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SHIVER.description: This creature's attacks fail this turn.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_PARALYSIS.title: Paralysis
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_PARALYSIS.description: The next attack fails and consumes 1 Paralysis. Stacks up to 3.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_POISON.title: Poison
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_POISON.description: At end of turn, lose HP equal to Poison, then reduce Poison by 1.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_REGEN.title: Regen
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_REGEN.description: At end of turn, heal HP equal to Regen, then reduce Regen by 1.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_FORCED_EXIT.title: Forced Exit
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_FORCED_EXIT.description: This creature immediately leaves the current combat.
